messages.subject: Project Sable - Report on Title
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla,

Our Report on Title is attached. In short, title is good and marketable and we can recommend you proceed, subject to two pre-completion items: (1) discharge of the seller's Clydesford Bank charge (we'll hold an undertaking); and (2) assignment of the Northbridge rent deposit (£121,500).

Please note the Northbridge break at Sep 2026 (28.9% of income) and the £20,000 retention we've agreed for the first-floor service charge query. SDLT will be £1,227,000 and we'll need your VAT registration and option to tax confirmations before completion for the TOGC.

Happy to take the board through it. Let me know if you'd like a call.

Best,
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

---
This email and any attachments are confidential and may be legally privileged.
